title: Rabbi Zeira bar Zevid
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Seder HaDorot says, “I did not find him.” Otzar Yisrael then gives [Berakhot 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.38a.16) as his source, but Hyman says it misunderstood the plain sense of the Gemara: the rabbis praised the son of Rav Zevid, brother of Rabbi Shmuel bar Rav Zevid, to Rabbi Zeira, saying that the son of Rav Zevid was a great man. Hyman regards this as clear.[^1]

notes.text: The rabbis praise an unnamed son of Rav Zevid to Rabbi Zeira. The son’s brother is Rabbi Shmuel. Hyman quotes Heilprin as saying “I did not find him.” The [linked Warsaw-edition entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1118&lang=en) calls Zeira bar Zavi a scribal error and refers readers to Rav Zevid.
